newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian officials safe in helicopter emergency.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian officials safe in helicopter emergency.

text.p: Two Indonesian government ministers and other officials escaped unhurt when their helicopter made an emergency landing at an airport on the western tip of Sumatra on Thursday, Antara news agency reported.
The official news agency said The Puma helicopter was one of several carrying officials and ministers travelling with President Suharto in Aceh province. No other helicopters were involved.
Antara said none of the officials, including Health Minister Sujudi and Food Minister Ibrahim Hasan, was hurt.
Suharto returned to Jakarta later in the day after visiting Aceh for a ceremony involving a village improvement organisation.

Antara quoted airline officials as saying the helicopter involved in the incident made an emergency landing because of engine trouble shortly after taking off from Banda Aceh airport. It gave no further details.
Officials denied an earlier report from airport sources that the passengers had included Suharto's daughter-in-law, Halima, wife of his second son, businessman Bambang Trihatmodjo.
